g.text: log.debug("Detected that all consumers were subscribed to same set of topics, invoking the "+"optimized assignment algorithm")
log.debug("Detected that not all consumers were subscribed to same set of topics, falling back to the "+"general case assignment algorithm")

log.error("Found multiple consumers {} and {} claiming the same TopicPartition {} in the "+"same generation {}, this will be invalidated and removed from their previous assignment.",consumer,otherConsumer,tp,maxGeneration)
log.debug("Performing constrained assign with partitionsPerTopic: {}, consumerToOwnedPartitions: {}.",partitionsPerTopic,consumerToOwnedPartitions)

log.error("Found partition {} still claimed as owned by consumer {}, despite being claimed by multiple "+"consumers already in the same generation. Removing it from the ownedPartitions",doublyClaimedPartition,consumer)

log.debug("After reassigning previously owned partitions, unfilled members: {}, unassigned partitions: {}, "+"current assignment: {}",unfilledMembersWithUnderMinQuotaPartitions,unassignedPartitions,assignment)
log.error("No more unfilled consumers to be assigned. The remaining unassigned partitions are: {}",unassignedPartitions.subList(currentPartitionIndex,unassignedPartitions.size()))

log.error("Current number of members with more than the minQuota partitions: {}, is less than the expected number "+"of members with more than the minQuota partitions: {}, and no more partitions to be assigned to the remaining unfilled consumers: {}",currentNumMembersWithOverMinQuotaPartitions,expectedNumMembersWithOverMinQuotaPartitions,unfilledMembersWithUnderMinQuotaPartitions)

log.error("Consumer: [{}] should have {} partitions, but got {} partitions, and no more partitions "+"to be assigned. The remaining unfilled consumers are: {}",unfilledMember,minQuota,assignedPartitionsCount,unfilledMembersWithUnderMinQuotaPartitions)

log.trace("skip over this unfilled member: [{}] because we've reached the expected number of "+"members with more than the minQuota partitions, and this member already have minQuota partitions",unfilledMember)
log.info("Final assignment of partitions to consumers:
log.debug("performing general assign. partitionsPerTopic: {}, subscriptions: {}, currentAssignment: {}",partitionsPerTopic,subscriptions,currentAssignment)
log.info("Final assignment of partitions to consumers:
log.error("{} is assigned to more than one consumer.",topicPartition)
log.debug("{} can be moved from consumer {} to consumer {} for a more balanced assignment.",topicPartition,otherConsumer,consumer)
log.error("The consumer {} is assigned more partitions than the maximum possible.",consumer)
log.error("Expected more than one potential consumer for partition '{}'",partition)
log.error("Expected partition '{}' to be assigned to a consumer",partition)
